### Front line

Ukrainian open-source monitoring group DeepStateMap reported no changes in territorial control along the front lines, with zero square kilometers newly occupied or contested. 

The Russian Ministry of Defence claimed localized offensive operations and fire missions, asserting that tank crews struck Ukrainian positions in Zaporizhzhia Oblast and that drone units hit Ukrainian bunkers, equipment, and control points in the Kramatorsk and Orikhiv directions. Neutral open-source monitor GeoConfirmed cataloged video evidence of Russian forces shelling a claimed Ukrainian position in Kostiantynivka (Donetsk Oblast) and launching a fiber-optic drone against infantry. On the Ukrainian side, GeoConfirmed recorded an FPV drone strike by Ukraine's Luhansk National Police Regiment on a basement in Kostiantynivka. In addition, *The Economist* war-fire model detected two war-related satellite fires, both situated in Donetsk Oblast.

### Strikes and losses

The Russian Ministry of Defence claimed it carried out drone strikes against Ukrainian energy and logistics targets, asserting hits on a Nova Poshta facility in Novyi Korotych (Kharkiv Oblast), a 330 kV electrical substation in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, Kharkiv rail and energy infrastructure, and two commercial dry-cargo vessels allegedly transporting military cargo in the Black Sea, southwest of Odesa. The Russian ministry also claimed that its air defenses intercepted a total of 531 Ukrainian fixed-wing drones over 24 hours (496 overnight and 35 during the day) across numerous Russian regions and maritime areas. 

On the Ukrainian side, open-source monitor GeoConfirmed recorded footage of a reported fire burning in the distance at an oil refinery in Ryazan, Russia. GeoConfirmed also documented Russian FPV drone strikes that damaged a garbage truck in Kharkiv and a police SUV, as well as a Russian strike that killed a civilian woman. In the air, GeoConfirmed noted a Ukrainian FPV drone intercepting a Russian UAV, while the Russian MoD claimed its units destroyed Ukrainian drones mid-air over Dnipropetrovsk and the Krasny Lyman sector. 

Regarding equipment losses, independent visual trackers WarSpotting and lost_warinua recorded the destruction of a Russian 9K55 "Grad-1" rocket launcher in Belgorod Oblast and a KamAZ transport truck in Luhansk Oblast. The Telegram channel lost_warinua also posted claimed footage of a destroyed Ukrainian Roshel Senator armored vehicle in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast.

### Official statements

The Ministry of Defence of Ukraine announced government regulatory changes expanding private air defense initiatives, permitting vetted enterprises to utilize interceptor drones and manned aircraft under military command to protect infrastructure. The Ukrainian ministry also mandated that all armed forces food procurement transition to the digital "DOT-Chain Food" platform, launched a digital management course on the Army+ mobile app, published a warning reminding citizens of prison sentences for participating in mass riots, and stated that Ukraine's Defense Minister spoke with Turkey's Defense Minister concerning Black Sea navigation and corvette construction. 

The Russian Ministry of Defence reported that the Russian President instructed officials to establish a dedicated educational program for veterans of the military operation who lack higher education. Russian officials also issued official congratulations marking Military Intelligence Day.
